summary: Document two live-usage gotchas in SKILL.md and README.md: (1) generated GraphQL passthrough read commands ship a default --query with a stale example date and can silently return an empty/misleading result instead of erroring; (2) --replace-piece is effectively always required for meal set/meal set-all/reorder (Forkable auto-selects a candidate piece for every delivery day) and dry-run mode cannot validate its absence.
reason: Both gaps caused real, reproducible friction during a live lunch-ordering session: `deliveries list` with no flags returned {"count":0} despite 3 real upcoming deliveries (stale `from: "2026-01-01"` baked into the default query), and a `meal set --confirm` failed with a raw GraphQL error (`oldPieceId ... Expected value to not be null`) after an identical dry-run had rendered a clean, plausible-looking preview. The prior README wording ("omit it to add a new piece") was actively misleading: Forkable auto-selects a piece for every delivery before the user ever touches it, so there is effectively no delivery with a genuinely empty slot in practice. Neither gap is a code defect in this CLI — Forkable's own API behaves this way — so the fix is documentation, not code.
validated_outcome: Both docs updated consistently (SKILL.md and README.md carry matching caveat text); `cli-printing-press publish validate --dir` passes 11/11 checks after this patch (manifest, transcendence, phase5, go mod tidy, govulncheck, go vet, go build, --help, --version, verify-skill, manuscripts).
